title: ARD updates
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-04-22
html:
Summary

The Connector ARD has been updated to include a few new use cases, like:

  • On Hold Order Status
  • Get Warehouse API Calls
  • Toggle Options for Product fields
  • Listing Schemas for Categories
  • Check Prerequisites before product listing

Additionally, a new Customer Service ARD has also been published.
